newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia sees Svyazinvst interest, bids unclear.
newsitem.headline: Russia sees Svyazinvst interest, bids unclear.

text.p: About 16-18 potential buyers have indicated interest in a 25 percent plus one shares stake in Russian telecoms holding Svyazinvest, chairman of the State Committee for Communications Alexander Krupnov said on Tuesday.
Igor Lipkin, chairman of the Russian Federal Property Fund, which is organising the auction, declined to say whether any bids had been made so far at an auction due to open on Monday.
But Krupnov said Russian and foreign investment groups, banks and telecom operators had come to a meeting on the auction at the communications committee about two weeks ago.
"All in all there were about 16-18 participants," he said. "I can say many people look on this positively...Everyone says with a single voice that there is interest."

The stake in Svyazinvest, which owns controlling interests in 85 regional telecoms companies, will be auctioned on July 25, officials said this week. The starting price for the stake is $1.18 billion.
